ideas.pitch: A Python decision engine that models risk-adjusted return on investment for data packs, dynamically bidding on data only when the marginal information gain exceeds the auction price.
ideas.title: NovaCredit Budget Optimizer Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins on the Smart Spending and Portfolio Profit criteria by treating data acquisition as a knapsack problem with uncertainty, directly addressing the core tension of the challenge.

ideas.pitch: A risk-scoring pipeline built with LightGBM and SHAP values to generate the required one-page memo, ensuring credit decisions are mathematically justified and demonstrably fair.
ideas.title: FairLend Explainability Wrapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Memo judging criterion by automatically generating clear, audit-ready fairness metrics and variable importance charts for the judges.

ideas.pitch: A Monte Carlo simulation tool to test credit card assignment strategies against rival bidding behaviors and hidden default probabilities before locking in final choices.
ideas.title: Adverse Selection Simulation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes Portfolio Profit by stress-testing the lending portfolio against worst-case hidden default distributions rather than relying on simple averages.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping script that evaluates the incremental predictive power of each available data pack against its auction cost using cross-validation.
ideas.title: Dynamic Data Pack ROI Calculator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins Smart Spending by mathematically proving which data packs were treasure and which were traps, providing the exact justification needed for the memo.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end pipeline that ingests baseline and purchased datasets, trains a tiered risk model, maps applicants to optimal card tiers, and compiles the final submission package.
ideas.title: Automated Credit Policy Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures all deliverables (card decisions, notebook, and one-page memo) are fully automated and error-free within the tight 4-hour window.
